question: List order IDs and amounts for orders worth at least 30000 INR, ordered by order ID.
gold_sql: SELECT id, amount FROM public.orders WHERE amount >= 30000 ORDER BY id

question: List customer IDs and names for customers in Chennai, ordered by customer ID.
gold_sql: SELECT id, name FROM public.customers WHERE city = 'Chennai' ORDER BY id

question: List the IDs and names of customers who have placed one or more orders. Return one row per customer, ordered by customer ID.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM public.customers AS c LEFT JOIN public.orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 1 ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 100;

question: What is the average amount of an individual order in INR across all orders? Return one value.
List customer IDs, names, and order counts for customers with at least two orders, sorted by customer ID.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM public.customers AS c JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2 ORDER BY c.id

question: Return the two largest orders, showing order ID and amount. Sort by amount descending, then order ID ascending to break ties.
gold_sql: SELECT id, amount FROM public.orders ORDER BY amount DESC, id ASC LIMIT 2
